summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Sintesa Tembakau Nusantara MVP. Backend: 25/26 pytest passed (96%). Frontend: all major flows working — login (all 6 roles), demo quick-fill buttons, dashboard KPIs, supply chain visualization, sidebar role filtering, public consumer portal with TERVERIFIKASI OTENTIK badge and journey timeline, blockchain explorer, analytics charts (8 recharts), contracts (SC-001/002/003), users management. Auth via httpOnly cookies with secure+samesite=none works over HTTPS preview URL. Hash chain SHA-256 verification returns valid=true. Smart-contract exception detection (>5% qty mismatch) triggers correctly and admin can resolve.

minor.issue: Seeded retail batch RB-0001 is created WITHOUT product_id because seed_db calls create_batch('RB', ...) without passing extra={'product_id': ...}. The /api/retail route generates product_id but seed_db bypasses it. Consequence: consumer portal /verify/{product_id} cannot verify the seeded RB-0001 (only manually-created RB batches have product_id). Fix: in server.py line ~714, add extra={'product_id': f'PRD-{secrets.token_hex(4).upper()}'} to the seed create_batch('RB', ...) call.

issues: Spec says farmer should see 'only Registrasi Panen' but farmer actually sees 7 items (Dasbor, Registrasi Panen, Traceability, Blockchain Explorer, Smart Contracts, IoT & Kualitas, Anomali). Not necessarily a bug — likely intentional read-only access — but confirm with product spec.

action_items: Fix seed_db to include product_id when creating seeded RB-0001 (so consumer portal can verify seeded product). One-line change in /app/backend/server.py at the seed create_batch('RB', ...) call — add extra={'product_id': f'PRD-{secrets.token_hex(4).upper()}'}. After fix, drop the batches collection to re-seed.
Confirm intended sidebar visibility for farmer role vs spec statement 'farmer sees only Registrasi Panen'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 748 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider splitting into modules (auth, ledger, batches, stats, seed).
trace() forward-walk uses forward=nexts[0] which mutates without stringifying _id for subsequent iterations if the pattern were extended; currently OK but fragile.
compute_hash uses json.dumps with default=str — good, but any dict field ordering change in payload will break existing block verification. Acceptable for MVP.
CORS allow_origins hardcodes localhost:3000 in addition to FRONTEND_URL — fine for dev, but consider env-driven origin list.
set_auth_cookies uses secure=True + samesite='none' which is correct for cross-site HTTPS preview but will fail on plain http://localhost — dev-only login might need conditional cookie flags.
seed_data_creation: Tests created additional HB/CB/PB/SB/RB batches (chain) and one CB with 50% qty mismatch (open exception). Also invited a test user then deleted it. Seeded chain HB-0001..RB-0001 still present but RB-0001 has no product_id (bug).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully validated by /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 26 tests). Only failing test test_public_verify_seeded — will pass once main agent adds product_id to seed_db RB creation and DB is re-seeded. Frontend playwright checks confirmed: login redirect, dashboard KPIs, sidebar role filter, public /verify shows big green TERVERIFIKASI OTENTIK badge + journey timeline, explorer, contracts, analytics with 8 recharts SVGs, users management page loads. Public preview URL https://supply-verify-17.preview.emergentagent.com works with cookies over HTTPS.
rca of the issue: seed_db bug: /api/retail route generates product_id via `extra={'product_id': ...}` param to create_batch, but seed_db's create_batch('RB', ...) call omits that extra. Result: seeded RB-0001 batch document has no product_id field, so /api/public/verify/{product_id} cannot locate it and consumer portal cannot verify the demo product without first manually creating a retail batch.
